segs.en: What do you do when Gemini gets overconfident?

segs.zh: 我的观察力太敏锐了！直接把病根切出来了！
segs.en: My eye is razor-sharp! I cut the root cause right out!

segs.zh: 简单。再召唤一只 Gemini，让它俩互相哈气。
segs.en: Easy. Summon a second Gemini and let them hiss at each other.

segs.zh: 这就是，哈基米哈气审查。
第一局，哈气找 Bug。两只哈基米同时潜入代码库，每抓到一只虫子，就在通道里登记。
segs.en: Round one: the bug hunt. Both dive into the codebase and register every bug they catch.

segs.zh: 抓到了！空指针，第四十二行！
segs.en: Got one! Null pointer, line forty-two!

segs.zh: 哈——！慢了一爪！这只虫子已经被我叼走了！
segs.en: Hiss! Too slow by a paw! I already snatched that one!

segs.zh: 重复登记，当场拦截。抓得多的，拿下一胜。
segs.en: Duplicates are blocked on the spot. Most bugs takes round one.

segs.zh: 第二局，交叉修复。你修我的 Bug，我修你的 Bug，各自在独立的工作树里并行开工。
segs.en: Round two: cross-fixing. Each fixes the other's bugs, in parallel, in isolated worktrees.

segs.zh: 这也叫修好了？打回重修！
segs.en: You call that fixed? Rejected. Do it again!

segs.zh: 互哈互验之后，由铲屎官亲自裁决。修得更完美的，拿下二胜。
segs.en: After mutual hiss-checks, the human makes the final call. The cleaner fix takes round two.

segs.zh: 上下文长期保持，随时复审、重修。
segs.en: Context persists, so re-reviews and re-fixes are always on call.

segs.zh: 依旧两哈基米相互哈气，就算审查了！
segs.en: Two Geminis hissing at each other: that counts as code review!

segs.zh: 哈基米哈气审查，Antigravity 插件。
segs.en: Hakimi Hiss Duel. A plugin for Antigravity.
